temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth tells Keith she is not upset with him; her short responses are due to personal stuff, and she apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth may be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her curtness is not about him but is caused by personal stress she is dealing with.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not angry with him; she is going through personal difficulties.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and offer support if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts Keith's offer to talk or take a coffee break and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress, is not upset with him, and may welcome his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; she is receptive to his support and appreciates his offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is open to receiving support from him, and a coffee break seems welcome.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To listen to her and support her during the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth shares more about severe personal stresses and says she has thought about professional help but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under significant personal stress and has accepted his supportive gesture; he wants to help her through it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her stress seems severe, and although professional help might benefit her, she is hesitant about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help could be beneficial for Elizabeth, but she is hesitant and may need gentle support without pressure.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, caring, and uncertain about not offending her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support her carefully and avoid pressuring her while considering whether professional help could be helpful.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his professional-help suggestion; she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and it is just a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Professional help may benefit Elizabeth; she is hesitant, and he may have overstepped or embarrassed her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; she explicitly says he did not overstep and appreciates his concern, though she needs time to process.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not offend or embarrass her; she appreciates his support, but the topic is heavy and she needs space and time.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and worried before her response; afterward, relieved and empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her, give her space, and remain available without pressuring her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth says his support means a lot to her and that she feels better knowing she has it; she seems more open and appreciative.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciated his concern but was processing a lot, so he should remain supportive without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; she values his support and feels more comfortable and positive around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support, feels better knowing he is there, and their supportive relationship is strengthened.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks.
